questionEn: Which option correctly reveals the meaning of “proposed chromatography”?
questionUz: Qaysi variant “taklif etilayotgan xromatografiya” ma’nosini to‘g‘ri ochib beradi?
choicesEn: M. S. Light in 1903 (later called the chromatographic method)
choicesUz: 1903 yilda M. S. Light (keyinchalik xromatografik usul deb ataladi)
explanationEn: M. S. Light - adsorption analysis (1903), chromatography (1906).
explanationUz: M. S. Nur - adsorbsion tahlil (1903), xromatografiya (1906).
